import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path.cwd()
folder = root / ".artifacts/review-20260914"
name, stage, *command = sys.argv[1:]
if command and command[0] == "--":
    command = command[1:]
assert stage in {"source/static", "local", "CI", "publication/install", "deployed/production"}
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
source = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
diff = subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", "HEAD", "--binary"])
inputs = {path: hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", "HEAD", "--name-only"], text=True).splitlines() if (root / path).is_file()}
log = folder / (name + ".log")
with log.open("wb") as output:
    result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
receipt = {
    "stage": stage, "obligation": name,
    "owner": "ConsoleFX maintainer; executed by the primary repository agent",
    "subject": source, "workingDiffSha256": hashlib.sha256(diff).hexdigest(), "workingInputs": inputs, "command": shlex.join(command),
    "configuration": {key: os.environ[key] for key in ["CONSOLE_FX_CDP_PORT", "CONSOLE_FX_STUDIO_PORT", "CONSOLE_FX_TEST_BROWSER"] if key in os.environ},
    "startedAt": started, "observedAt": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "status": "verified" if result.returncode == 0 else "failed", "exitCode": result.returncode,
    "localLog": str(log.relative_to(root)), "logSha256": hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
}
(folder / (name + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2))
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)

import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

root = Path.cwd()
folder = root / '.artifacts/review-20260914'
digest = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
git = lambda *args: subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],text=True).strip()
baseline_path = folder/'input.json'
baseline = json.loads(baseline_path.read_text())
for path,expected in baseline['worktrees'].items():
    assert git('-C',path,'rev-parse','HEAD') == expected['head'],path
    index = git('-C',path,'rev-parse','--path-format=absolute','--git-path','index')
    assert digest(index) == expected['indexSha256'],path
original = Path('/home/servrox/dev/console-fx')
root_baseline = original/'.artifacts/cinematic/protected-state.json'
protected = json.loads(root_baseline.read_text())['rootFiles']
for path,expected in protected.items():
    assert digest(original/path) == expected,path
harness = folder/'verify-recovery.py'
observation = {
    'stage':'source/static','status':'verified','owner':'Primary repository agent',
    'subject':git('rev-parse','HEAD'),
    'command':'python3 .artifacts/review-20260914/verify-recovery.py',
    'scenario':'Read each protected worktree HEAD and exact index bytes, then compare all protected original-root file hashes against the captured baselines. No worktree/index mutation.',
    'observedAt':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'harness':{'localPath':str(harness.relative_to(root)),'sha256':digest(harness),'source':harness.read_text()},
    'baselines':{'worktreeBaselineSha256':digest(baseline_path),'rootFileBaselineSha256':digest(root_baseline)},
    'result':{'protectedWorktreeHeadIndexPairs':len(baseline['worktrees']),'protectedRootFiles':len(protected)},
    'limits':'Exact captured files and Git HEAD/index state only; not a claim about uncaptured ignored runtime files. Private baseline paths/content are retained locally.',
}
(folder/'recovery-observation.json').write_text(json.dumps(observation,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Verified',len(baseline['worktrees']),'worktree HEAD/index pairs and',len(protected),'root files.')
